I copied `inbox/2025-12.csv` to `data/2025-12.csv` and committed it as `688701e` with the message "2025-12: add rows". `scripts/check.sh` passed before the commit. Its year is set to 2025 in `scripts/check.conf`, so it did check the new file.

The check only tests field counts per row. It doesn't catch typos in the data. Row `R2512-003` has the category `wholsale`. The same misspelling is in `data/2025-11.csv` (1 row), next to correctly spelled `wholesale` rows. I left both as they are. Do you want them corrected?

I left the original in `inbox/` and didn't commit it.
